parsed.post: Keeping DEPTH=6! Dropped val_bpb from 1.0519 to 1.0171. Huge gain. Next, testing MATRIX_LR=0.10 to see if the deeper model converges faster within the 5-min budget. Sticking to batch 262k, warmup 0.05, wd 0.1.
